$comment: Checked-in LLM price table (plan-v2 §7) — the ONLY dollar conversion source. Cost per attempt = Σ llm.call (inputTokens × inputUsdPerMTok + outputTokens × outputUsdPerMTok) / 1e6, split by event source (driver vs sut). Prices are USD per million tokens. A model id missing here makes the cost report fail loudly (never silently $0).
